Discord Public Server Messages to Appear in Google Search Results

28 Oct 2026, 05:08 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Tech Desk · Source: www.engadget.com

1 min read

Key takeaways

Image: www.engadget.com · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9; original source image

In this article
  1. New Visibility Standards
  2. Privacy and User Control

New Visibility Standards

Starting mid-December, public messages within Discord’s "Discoverable Servers"—communities with at least 1,000 members—may appear in web search results. Discord is introducing Server Web Pages that index channel discussions, similar to how public forums like Reddit are currently indexed. Notably, individual usernames and avatars will remain hidden.

Privacy and User Control

While the change aims to improve information discoverability, privacy remains a concern. Server administrators can currently opt-out specific channels. Individual users may also adjust their preferences via the "Data and Privacy" settings. Users in the EU, UK, Canada, Brazil, Australia, and South Korea are opted-out by default due to local regulations, and teen users are excluded from this feature entirely. Private servers and direct messages remain unaffected. For further information and settings management, visit Discord's official source.
